claims.claim: CORRECTION of the mission shorthand: the run3 pad failure is phase=6 = PadPhase::Open (scePadOpen) with error -2137915388 = 0x80920004 = PS5_PAD_ERROR_ALREADY_OPENED (pinned vendor constant, worker-pad-hardware-probe/src/pad_sdl_ps5.h:21), NOT 0x80A40004 and NOT 'pad service unavailable'. The pad open was refused because a handle for that user was ALREADY OPEN in the process - i.e. the game's own pad stack had already opened the pad by the time our composition tried, at the EARLIEST practical injection moment.
claims.evidence: run3-runtime-status.txt + run3-ue4ss.log 'phase=6, error=-2137915388'; PS5PadSource.hpp:10-11 enum (Uninitialized=0 ... Open=6); pad_sdl_ps5.h:21

claims.claim: Injection-timing fact, live: composition module_start begins at the earliest injectable point of the new game process (ploader polls pids at 50ms, S03/S07; readiness min ~1.6s, S08; module space at walk time only 10028-22761 VM entries) and the pad open fires ~790-800ms into it (bounded between lmf_intervals_found +790ms and runtime_start_failed +800ms, pid 355). The game therefore opens its pad within roughly the first ~2-28s of process life - BEFORE the earliest possible injection. All three boots failed fail-closed with no retry (single-shot; runtime-status written once at the refusal moment, t=60900572 = +791ms).

Pad-defer retry-window inference (flagged inference, not measurement): the fix's window is NOT 'wait until the pad service is up' (it is already up, see T06) but 'wait until the game's exclusive handle is free', and WHEN (if ever) the game releases it is unmeasured - no successful open exists anywhere in this evidence. A fixed boot-relative delay is therefore unjustified; retry should be event-driven (re-attempt activate() on each poll/tick or on Disconnected transitions, cheap and bounded). Lower bound only: the same process was still executing injected module_starts at least ~71-73s after injection (PATH_TEST stamps), so any deferred retry lands while the game is up.

honesty: No game-process spawn timestamp exists in the evidence; all 'after process start' statements are bounds/inference from pinned ploader behavior (S03-S08), clearly flagged.

The ~71s inter-plugin gap is measured end-to-end but NOT decomposed; readiness/attach/load attribution inside it is inference from pinned source and is explicitly marked as exceeding the source's modeled worst case, requiring PATCH ploader-03 instrumentation to resolve.

Pre-module_start costs (composition readiness, attach, kernel load of the 30MB image) are NOT visible to sdiag (they happen before the first stamp) and remain unmeasured; the projection band '5-10s' for them is neither confirmed nor refuted, only made irrelevant to game-thread blocking by T02/T05.

C_comp is reported under BOTH definitions the mission offered; the projection-relevant one is the module_start_return delta (~0.8s), because the extra ~4.9s of sdiag records is post-return worker-thread activity (T02).
The mission's stated pad error 0x80A40004 does not match the evidence (0x80920004); the measured value and its vendor-constant name are reported (T06).
Critic-style scores are out of scope; numbers above are reproducible by re-running the extraction against the hashed inputs.
